profile_identity: Historical study label for the 2026-07-27 controls; the final qualified configuration is gpt-oss-120b-mi350x-qualified-v4.

topology.conclusion: XGMI path locality is uniform. Noncanonical rank sets showed long-run instability in both fused and unfused controls and are excluded from performance qualification.

root_causes.name: invasive custom deep health
root_causes.mechanism: HealthCheck enqueues a one-token generation and may cancel/abort it after any unrelated scheduler output.
evidence: generate and passive_when_busy modes emitted HEALTH_CHECK_* M=1 batches
fully passive mode emitted no HEALTH_CHECK_* generation
input ring with generate health still timed out
passive health is required even with input-ring buffering

root_causes.name: host-alternated no-exit ring phase
root_causes.mechanism: Mutable host slot alternation during graph capture does not establish one graph-stable phase across all captured variants and request waves.
evidence: one long unfused physical-GPU-6 control passed, but later noncanonical unfused campaigns also timed out
short fused workload passed on physical GPU 6
long fused workload faulted on physical GPU 6
long fused workload passed twice with the ring but later canonical ring runs faulted
two order-opposed graph passes saved 5.37 us/site, proving performance but not serving lifetime safety

fix.current: retain the original one-slot exit barrier
fix.future: assign ring slots explicitly per graph/call site or use a device-side epoch before omitting the exit barrier

root_causes.name: overlapped M/graph transitions
root_causes.mechanism: Later request waves change active M while overlap scheduling is still draining prior work, so TP ranks can enter different graph/barrier phases.
evidence: input ring plus passive health still faulted in a later small prefill wave
fixed grid 32 passed decode but deadlocked the first canonical M=128 prefill bucket
disabling overlap scheduling passed all canonical prefill buckets and decode while retaining the M-dependent grid
two consecutive long physical-GPU-6 runs passed without overlap

serving_matrix.result: passed in one run but later failed without fixed participants

fixed_grid_decode_control.result: all three long decode servers passed

full_smoke.result: all six prefill buckets followed by decode passed on one server

decision.m256_gate: rejected after timing out on the stable baseline control
decision.latest_followup: Reserved-sink request padding and persistent per-site fused outputs closed both graph-lifetime faults. The full three-block/fifteen-pair campaign passed safety but rejected promotion on decode performance.
